label: Magicshine Controls
description: Control supported Magicshine lights from the Karoo app or the in-ride field, with lamp selection, quick beam switching, and battery and temperature telemetry.
releaseNotes:
* Reduced BLE scanning and retry churn when the lamp is not nearby
* Added fresh no-lamp retry from the ride button
* Added fresh no-lamp retry from the app connect button
* Improved ride disconnect and field state handling
